339-677-4050-8296.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Jegantha, adding one mana of any color
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2829-4574-6900-7435--44.description:
Sacrifice the templated artifact.
Resolve the ability of your sacrifice outlet.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Arcbound Reclaimer, putting the artifact on top of your library.
Your leaves-the-graveyard effect triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast the templated artifact for 0 life through Gwenom.
Repeat.
2829-4574-6900-7435--44.notes:
This combo will only result in creature ETB/LTB/etc. if the chosen card from the template is an artifact creature, in which case creature-specific sacrifice outlets may also be used.
For artifacts from the template that can sacrifice themselves, the free sacrifice outlet is unnecessary.

1957-4050-5708--173.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature castable for {0}, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, Vein Ripper triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast that creature by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2866-3518-3899-4986.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

622-757-5087-6702.easyPrerequisites:
Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Kilo, or you have another method to tap Kilo.
622-757-5087-6702.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Kilo to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Kamahl, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

1308-2557-5478-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
1308-2557-5478-6441-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

392-2438-5220-7855--180.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Goblin, Orc or Army
When the Goblin, Orc or Army dies, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}
Repeat
392-2438-5220-7855--180.notes: The chosen Goblin, Orc or Army must be castable for {R}.

478-1399-2404-7775.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
478-1399-2404-7775.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle and Wirewood Lodge.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Formidable Speaker.
Activate Formidable Speaker by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Candelabra of Tawnos.
Repeat.

955-3259-4053-7604.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control with mana value 3 or less.
You either control another nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less, or have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
955-3259-4053-7604.description:
Declare Excava and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Excava triggers, returning up to one creature with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to another creature with mana value 3 or less, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
955-3259-4053-7604.notes: If both creatures used have haste, you can ignore the haste enabler.

Activate Solarion by tapping it, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Solarion using Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Solarion.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5231-6730-6972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing it
When Thermopod dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Sin.
When Sin dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Sin from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. As Sin enters, remove the -1/-1 counter from Thermopod, causing Sin to enter with a +1/+1 counter on it instead.
Resolve the second Sin trigger, putting the counters it had on it when it was sacrificed onto a creature you control and failing to shuffle it into your library as it's no longer in your graveyard.
Repeat.

2533-4681-6797-6913.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Chameleon from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Chameleon enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Chameleon.
Repeat.

1055-5200-7059.description:
Activate The Walls of Ba Sing Se by tapping it, causing a player to mill thirty cards.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping The Walls of Ba Sing Se.
Repeat as mana allows.
1055-5200-7059.notes: This combo can be repeated each turn as mana allows.

1987-3980-4423-6650.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Sisay's Ring by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Sisay's Ring.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

5776-5777-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
5776-5777-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing any other creature.
Because the creature is a Food due to Ygra, when it dies, Camellia and Ygra trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Camellia trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

413-3781-4215--124.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another nontoken green Insect.
When the Insect dies, Zask and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Zask trigger, putting the Insect on the bottom of your library from your graveyard and causing you to mill two cards.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for that Insect and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the Insect enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
413-3781-4215--124.notes: Eventually the combo will stop in step 3, as the Insect will be milled into your graveyard. Note that you must control another nontoken green Insect besides Zask.

1350-4010-4231-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton either from your hand or from the command zone by paying at least {3}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens, three Food tokens, three Clue tokens and three Treasure tokens.
Activate eight of the artifact tokens by tapping them, adding {5}{G}{W}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1-5014-5796-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
You have a card in hand.

1-5014-5796-6282.description:
Activate Putrid Imp by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Putrid Imp ability.
Repeat.

4404-5640-5917.description:
Activate a mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting the mana-producing creature.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying The Jolly Balloon Man's ability, targeting Corridor Monitor.
Resolve the copy of The Jolly Balloon Man's ability, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor that is a 1/1 Balloon with haste.
When Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping The Jolly Balloon Man.
Resolve the Jolly Ballon Man ability from step 2, creating a token copy of the mana-producing creature that is a 1/1 Balloon with haste.
Activate the mana-producing creature token by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Adaptive Gemguard by tapping the Saprolings, putting a +1/+1 counter on Adaptive Gemguard.
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {1}.

1987-2493-3120.notablePrerequisites:
Mindsplice Apparatus has at least two oil counters on it.
You control a permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
1987-2493-3120.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking Archaeomancer and the mana-producing permanent.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2493-2596-3542-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{B}{B}.
2493-2596-3542-5147.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{B}{B}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Archaeomancer and Palinchron, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Living Death by paying {3}{B}{B}, causing each player to exile all creature cards from their graveyard, sacrifice all creatures they control, then return all cards exiled this way to the battlefield.
Archaeomancer and Palinchron enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Living Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Repeat.
If the seven lands can tap to produce at least {4}{B}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1608-1651-2034-2382.description:
Activate Mimic Vat by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Triplicate Titan with haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Triplicate Titan token, adding {C}{C}.
The token Triplicate Titan dies, creating three 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Golems, untapping Mimic Vat.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Golem, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

232-1693-3750-3851.notablePrerequisites:
Blade of Selves attached to Priest of Urabrask.
Priest of Urabrask does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least two opponents.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Priest of Urabrask.

Declare Priest of Urabrask as an attacker.
Priest of Urabrask' myriad ability triggers, creating at least two token copies of it that are tapped and attacking.
The Priest of Urabrask tokens enter the battlefield, adding at least six {R}.
At the end of your combat phase, Blade of Selves triggers, exiling the Priest of Urabrask tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.

1518-1987-2556.description:
Activate Will's second ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing target player to draw two cards and causing all instant, sorcery and planeswalker spells you cast to cost {2} less this turn.
Activate the aritfact and/or land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking Mnemonic Wall and the artifact and/or land.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Ghostly Flicker from the graveyard to your hand.
